reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: Under RA 9514 Section 10.2.5.2(B), what fire-resistance rating is required for a protected exit separation when the exit connects four or more storeys?
proposed.rationale: A protected exit connecting four or more storeys requires at least two-hour fire resistance.
proposed.explanation: The edit removes unsupported fire-door rating wording and asks the source-backed protected-exit rating.
